rationale: Archive Alto from the infrastructure-fund PortCo census and retract the erroneous CDPQ ownership period. Alto is the brand of VIA HFR–VIA TGF Inc., a federal agent Crown corporation wholly owned by VIA Rail, while CDPQ Infra is an equity member and lead of the separate Projet Cadence Rail developer vehicle. The March 2025 project-development agreement is a co-development contract rather than an Alto equity purchase or closed concession, and no signed Alto ownership transfer was found.

supports: VIA HFR–VIA TGF Inc. is owned by VIA Rail
Alto is a federal Crown project entity rather than a CDPQ portfolio company
Projet Cadence Rail is the private developer vehicle
CDPQ Infra is an equity member of Cadence rather than an owner of Alto
The project financial structure remained to be developed
The project remained in early market engagement before a federal final investment decision in 2026

beforeImage.name: Alto
beforeImage.description: Alto is the high-speed rail project selected to connect Toronto and Québec City. Its counterparties are public-sector sponsors and future rail users rather than conventional utility or commodity customers. The business is development-stage and infrastructure-heavy because value depends on route design, civil works, rolling stock, and long-term concession or project-delivery arrangements. Public materials describe the corridor at roughly 1,000 kilometers across Ontario and Québec. Its principal operating footprint is the Toronto-Québec City corridor. CDPQ Infra leads the Cadence consortium selected to develop the project, and public materials reviewed do not disclose detailed ownership percentages for consortium participants.

milestones.event: Alto and the CDPQ Infra-led Cadence consortium signed the development contract for the Toronto-Québec City high-speed rail project.
The Government of Canada selected Cadence as preferred private developer partner for the Alto high-speed rail project.
Alto branding was adopted for the high-speed rail project.

afterImage.name: Alto
afterImage.description: Archived PortCo-census record for Alto, the brand used by VIA HFR–VIA TGF Inc. and its planned approximately 1,000-kilometre Toronto–Québec City high-speed rail network. VIA HFR–VIA TGF Inc. was incorporated on November 29, 2022 as a wholly owned subsidiary of VIA Rail Canada Inc. and operates as a federal agent Crown corporation. The Government of Canada selected the Cadence consortium as private developer in February 2025, and Alto and Cadence signed a project-development agreement in March 2025 to undertake route, design, environmental, land and financial-structure work. CDPQ Infra leads and holds equity in the separate Projet Cadence Rail developer vehicle; that interest does not constitute equity ownership of Alto. June 2026 market engagement remained part of early procurement before Canada's final investment decision. No CDPQ or CDPQ Infra acquisition of Alto shares or assets, closed concession, external sale or signed pending Alto ownership transfer was identified through August 23, 2026. The record is archived because Alto is a government-owned project entity rather than an infrastructure-fund portfolio company.

milestones.event: VIA HFR–VIA TGF Inc. was incorporated as VIA Rail Canada's wholly owned federal Crown subsidiary.
The Government of Canada announced the Alto high-speed rail program and selected Cadence as its private developer partner.
Alto and Cadence signed the project-development agreement and began co-development; the agreement did not transfer ownership of Alto to Cadence or CDPQ Infra.
